lead: KL Rahul is a widely followed Indian cricketer, born on 18 April 1992 in Bengaluru.
As of 2026, he is 34 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Karnataka cricket team.
Below you will find a verified overview of KL Rahul: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: KL Rahul — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: KL Rahul was born on 18 April 1992 in Bengaluru, and holds Indian nationality.

sections.heading: KL Rahul — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer as his main occupation.

On the team sheet, KL has been associated with India national cricket team (from 2014 to 2018), Karnataka cricket team (from 2010), Royal Challengers Bengaluru (from 2013 to 2013), Royal Challengers Bengaluru (from 2016 to 2017), Sunrisers Hyderabad (from 2014 to 2015), Punjab Kings (from 2018 to 2021) and Lucknow Super Giants (from 2022).
